exhibitor_count.name: 展商数
exhibitor_count.definition: 某展会的参展商数量（去重）
exhibitor_count.status_reason: 数据可算，源已接入，待 F06 评测门禁升 VERIFIED
exhibitor_count.sql_template: SELECT exhibition_id, COUNT(DISTINCT exhibitor_id) AS exhibitor_count FROM ads_fct_exhibitor_participation GROUP BY exhibition_id

booth_revenue.name: 展位收入
booth_revenue.definition: 某展会的展位销售总收入
booth_revenue.status_reason: 数据可算，源已接入，待 F06 评测门禁升 VERIFIED
booth_revenue.sql_template: SELECT c.exhibition_id, SUM(c.contract_amount) AS booth_revenue FROM ads_fct_contract c GROUP BY c.exhibition_id

venue_utilization_rate.name: 场馆利用率（F3a）
venue_utilization_rate.definition: 某场馆某时段的利用率 = 已排档天数 / 可排档天数
venue_utilization_rate.status_reason: 已有口径，源已接入，待真库标定后升 VERIFIED
venue_utilization_rate.sql_template: SELECT venue_id, total_exhibition_count, avg_exhibitors_per_exhibition FROM ads_agg_venue_kpi

booth_sell_through_rate.name: 展位销售率
booth_sell_through_rate.definition: 某展会展位售出率 = 已售展位数 / 规划展位数

source.blocked_reason: B1/B2: 规划展位数与已售展位数的口径对齐受数据限制

booth_sell_through_rate.status_reason: 受 §5.5 B1/B2 限制，当前不可算；不得用 COALESCE(...,0) 补值
constraints: B1: 规划展位口径待统一
B2: 已售展位关联待接入
F04 §7.5: 禁止 COALESCE 补值

booth_vacancy_rate.name: 展位空置率
booth_vacancy_rate.definition: 某展会展位空置率 = 1 - 展位销售率

source.blocked_reason: B1/B2: 依赖展位销售率，同源受限

booth_vacancy_rate.status_reason: 受 §5.5 B1/B2 限制（依赖 booth_sell_through_rate），当前不可算
constraints: B1: 规划展位口径待统一
B2: 已售展位关联待接入
F04 §7.5: 禁止 COALESCE 补值
